definitions.content: fault which has a magnitude greater than the magnitude of the maximum permissible error on initial verification

notes.content: The following faults are considered to be not significant: (a) Fault arising from simultaneous and mutually independent causes in the instrument itself or in its checking facilities; (b) Faults implying the impossibility to perform any measurement; (c) Transitory faults being momentary variations in the indication, which cannot be interpreted, recorded or transmitted as a measurement result; and (d) Faults giving rise to variations in the measurement results that are so large as to be noticed by all those interested in the measurement result.
